summary.text: Desiree van Oosting is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 36 (Judson) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Desiree van Oosting's service as "Senate since 2025". The member page lists Desiree van Oosting's committee assignments as including the Energy and Natural Resources and the Human Services standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Desiree van Oosting's occupation as Small Business Owner, LMT.
It lists education as Attended NDSCS and MSU; Desert Institute of the Healing Arts.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: ND American Massage Therapy Association, Secretary (8 years), Outreach (11 years), Assembly of Delegates (4 years), Government relations (4 years).
Desiree van Oosting is listed as married to Bill.
